_comment: Defaults for gateway-guard. Override per project in .claude/gateway-guard.json, or point GATEWAY_GUARD_CONFIG at a file. Regex strings are case-insensitive.
_gatewayToolPrefixes: SET THIS to your gateway's MCP tool prefix. A server named 'gateway' gives mcp__gateway__; one shipped inside a plugin gives mcp__plugin_<plugin>_<server>__.

mcp._mode: 'deny-org-reaching' blocks non-gateway MCP tools whose name or input points at the org. 'allowlist' blocks every MCP tool not in gatewayToolPrefixes or allowedMcpPrefixes.

_allowPathPrefixes: Absolute paths whose files may mention the org (e.g. the gateway's own source). Empty by default: run gateway development in a different session from the plugin.
denyMessage: Blocked by gateway-guard: {reason}. Org data, metadata and deploys go through the gateway tools ({gateway}). If a gateway call is failing, stop and tell the user what failed. Do not try another route to the org.

receipts._claimPatterns: Signals that an answer states org data. Tune to your vocabulary; record IDs are the strongest signal.
receipts.blockMessage: Your answer states org data ({signal}) but no gateway call in this turn returned a receipt{failure}. Either call the gateway tools ({gateway}) and answer from their result, or tell the user you don't have the data. Do not answer from memory or from any other route.
